  rw [Measure.sum_apply _ hs, Measure.bind_apply hs (by fun_prop)]

  ext s hs
  rw [bind_apply hs κ.measurable, snd_apply hs, compProd_apply]
  · rfl

  rw [← snd_compProd]; infer_instance
